attach_file_content.description: Attaches persistent files or linked-folder images and reads source text by ID or path.
rules: ATTACH_FILE_CONTENT is the only file-content attachment marker.
Supply a persistent file ID to attach the whole text/image, or a linked-folder image path to send its pixels to vision.
Supply a text path to read a source window into FILE_CONTENT; #Lstart-Lend selects explicit lines and a bare text path continues from the next unread window.
Comma-separated references are processed in source order; preserve path case.
Wait for FOLLOW-UP before inspecting contents.
